title: Allah Janey Sain Zehra Kivay
body:
Allah janey sain Zehra kivay darbaar gayee
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq mangdhi rahi ro ro kay sitam gaara ko,
isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Paak Zahra ki guwaya si, musalman ada
Haye ummat edha vasda hoya ghar saar gaye
Isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Jidi thazeem layee khatmey, Rasool uthda si
Rondi mira deh ay veeran di ay hakdaar gaye
Isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Koun si ay jiney patlaya, Nabhi zaadi nu
Lekay pehlu chu zakham babay di ghum khar gaye
Isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sath Shabbir da maarkay vi naba vi Zainab
Esay laye Awn di maa Shaam deh bazaar gaye
Isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Rondey pitdey teri Zainab dey ,wafadar aye
Shaam nu ban key jo veeran di azadar gaye
Isko darbaar di peyshi eno tha maar gaye
